scope: Existing staging testnet; unchanged SDK and NEAR-only harness; no new resources.
method: Sequential control/candidate/control after local checks. Three fresh NEAR-only wallets attempted per arm. The final control failed one registration before any signature; the other eight wallets completed. SDK, Gateway, runtime, keys and APAC hints were fixed.

optionalControlRetry.reason: Two unfinished registration records remained after the original restoration. The optional retry was stopped before deployment or benchmark execution.

decision.implementation: Retain existing-schema initialization in early startup.
decision.reason: Startup now initializes the storage needed by the first operation. The direct change adds no table, cached flag, protocol state or authority record.
decision.hostedConclusion: No repeatable setup gain established by the small sequential sample.
followUpCandidates: Remove sequential D1 waits only with a verified admission guard.

controlFailure.stage: Deriver A prepare-work: tenant-root bound role-share lookup
controlFailure.handling: The failed attempt remains in the evidence. An optional replacement control was cancelled before any live change because new unfinished registration records remained after restoration.

roundTrips.scope: Bound-root role-private D1 only. Excludes root creation, other D1 work and local DO SQL.
roundTrips.change: Existing role schemas are initialized during early wallet startup. Normal requests keep their existing initialization path.

limitations: Three candidate wallets. The final control completed two of three wallets. The optional replacement control did not run.
Small sequential samples do not establish a percentile, a guaranteed saving or a setup regression.
The failed control attempt is retained. Browser latency statistics include completed workloads only.
Control-after server-stage statistics also include work from the failed attempt. Do not treat them as successful-setup-only measurements.
All local builds and E2Es finished before any hosted arm. Staging activation occurred before the first control.
Yao execute HTTP time excludes funding, NEAR account provisioning and the first signature. Registration-to-first timings include those steps.
Application clocks freeze during CPU work. Provider CPU and wall values describe whole invocations.
Fetch spans include processing, storage and transport. Stage medians cannot be added to reconstruct whole latency.
Actual placement was not remeasured. The preceding near-overlapped-target-20261008.json evidence records provider execution locations and separate D1 snapshots.
Six D1 calls and sixteen statements count only bound-root loads. Null Gateway counters are unavailable, not zero.
Local storage inspection is E2E instrumentation only. Hosted latency arms load the unwrapped production builds.
The implementation moves existing table creation earlier. It grants no wallet authority and creates no protocol, admission or activation records.

reproduction.local: Build the five strict release Workers at the source commit, then run each localVerification command with ROUTER_AB_WORKER_BUILD_PROFILE=release.
reproduction.hosted: .artifacts/r155b-phase6p-hosted/run.py runs the frozen NEAR-only harness with guarded versions, candidate deployment after local verification, two controls and finally restoration.
